# 🛑 DO NOT DIRECTLY EDIT UPSTREAM-SYNCED FILES 🛑

This directory contains both upstream-synced sources and locally maintained client libraries:

* `platform-lsp/`: Copied from JetBrains `intellij-community` (`platform/lsp`, `platform/lsp-impl`, `platform/lsp-impl/structureView`, plus their `resources/`). The copy script renames the package `com.intellij.platform.lsp` to `com.intellij.platform.dartlsp` and produces `platform-lsp/resources/dart-lsp-impl.xml` and `platform-lsp/resources/intentionDescriptions/DartLspIntention`. Any direct modifications must be codified in [`.agents/skills/patch-copied-lsp-sources/scripts/patch.py`](../../.agents/skills/patch-copied-lsp-sources/scripts/patch.py) so they persist during the next sync.
* `analysisServer/`: Originally taken from the Dart SDK's generated Java client (see [`analysisServer/readme.txt`](./analysisServer/readme.txt), `https://github.com/dart-lang/sdk/tree/main/pkg/analysis_server/tool/spec/generated/java`), licensed EPL v1.0 ([`analysisServer/LICENSE`](./analysisServer/LICENSE)).
  * `analysisServer/org/dartlang/analysis/server/protocol/*.java`: Protocol spec classes generated from upstream Dart SDK specs. The exception is `protocol/DartLspProtocol.kt`, which is hand-written Kotlin (DartLsp* LSP-over-legacy types).
  * `analysisServer/com/google/dart/server/`: Java client wrapper utilities that came from the Dart SDK and are now forked and maintained locally in this repository (for example, `generated/AnalysisServer.java` is "NO LONGER GENERATED: IT IS MAINTAINED BY HAND"). This includes [`internal/remote/utilities/RequestUtilities.java`](./analysisServer/com/google/dart/server/internal/remote/utilities/RequestUtilities.java). **Direct modifications here are permitted and expected** when updating client capability handshakes.
  * `analysisServer/org/osgi/framework/Version.java`: A single vendored OSGi Alliance class (Apache License 2.0 per its header, not EPL); treat as upstream code and avoid edits.
